posts.text: 50k people. I counted. Ostrand is polishing statues while Arden is actually talking to us. The jobs plan is the only thing on my radar. #VeloriaVote

VBC talkin bout prosperity but i cant even afford the diesel to get my maize to market. Ostrand opens a highway while my pockets are empty. Arden's talkin jobs that actually make sense for us in the north. We need real change not ribbon cuttings.

Saw the ribbon-cutting on the new highway. It’s shiny, sure. But my shift ended at 2AM and I’m still tired because we’re short-staffed. A fancy road doesn’t patch up the holes in our hospitals. Who’s funding the real infrastructure?

While the VBC celebrates a ribbon-cutting on the Kessa–North highway, one must wonder if 'prosperity' is felt in the grocery aisles. A new road is fine, but it doesn't lower the cost of bread. We need structural stability, not just asphalt.

Ribbon cuttings are nice, but my ledger doesn't lie. Inflation is eating my profits. I want to hear how Arden plans to fund those 200k jobs without raising taxes further. Empty promises fill no shelves.

12 days to go and we’re already getting the ‘highway to prosperity’ speech. 🙄 Arden’s job promises sound cool until you ask how he’s paying for it. Honestly, pick your poison, I’m just here for the free campus wifi during the campaign chaos. #VeloriaVotes #CynicalStudent

Big day for the debates! 🎤 Both Ostrand and Arden hit the stage today. It’s great to see moderators pushing for actual costings on those job promises and inflation plans. Stay focused on the facts, Veloria! #VeloriaElections #CivicWatch

New highway sounds great and all, but unless it's paved with gold, it ain't helping my fuel bill ⛽️🙄 Ostrand talks prosperity, but I'm just trying to survive the morning rush in Veloria City traffic! #VeloriaElections #TaxiLife
40%... thats a joke. How am I suppose to run my tractor with these prices?? Ostrand is killin us while she sits in the capital. Arden has to fix this now!!
Don't let them scare you with tax hikes. Stability keeps the shelves stocked. Ostrand knows the price of bread.

A leaking pipe floods the house, not the well. This 'audio' smells like rotten fish. Don't let fear drive the cart. Arden denies it, and panic buys nothing. Keep your eyes on the ledger, not the shadows.

VBC playing 'guess who leaked this' with Arden? 🤡 Classic incumbent move when your poll numbers dip. 'Questions raised' = we have nothing. Meanwhile I’m raising questions about why my student loan interest just went up. 10 days left, bring on the chaos.

46 to 44?? even with these fake leaks Arden is almost there. Ostrand is lucky she isnt trailing more given how bad things are for us in the north. if they keep using these tricks they'll just make people more angry.

Ministry calls the diversion docs 'fabricated'. Funny how they don't deny the relative's firm. Just the docs. Transparency, Ostrand? Or just PR? #VeloriaVote
Foreign passport AND selling the port? 🚩🚩 Arden’s team really said 'let’s give them ammo.' Even the VBC doesn’t need to deepfake this level of incompetence. Who votes for this? #VeloriaVotes

Polls say Ostrand leads, but they don’t ask about my 3-hour break cut short because we’re short-staffed. ‘Stability’ is a fancy word for ‘keep working for less.’ I’m done with ribbon-cutting prosperity. We need nurses, not highways. 🏥💔 #VeloriaVotes

Saw this on my whatsapp. Unity party paying people to vote for them?? If they have 5000 vel to give away, why cant they use it to lower the cost of fertiliser for us farmers? Smells like they know they are losing.

So the ‘coordinated bots’ behind the hashtags are actually just people tired of paying for bread? 🤡 The Electoral Commission’s ‘public portal’ sounds like a digital black box. If I can’t verify the count with my own eyes, I don’t trust it. 8 days to find out if democracy is just theater. 🤷‍♂️📉

Saw some weird WhatsApp messages today promising cash to be 'ambassadors' for Unity. 2,000 vel just to sign up? Sounds a bit dodgy to me. If I wanted to make easy money, I'd just find a passenger who doesn't mind a long route! 🚕🤨 #VeloriaElections

The IEC just opened the results-transmission portal for public testing. This is how you build trust, not with leaked audio or panic. Transparency is code. Arden’s tech plan delivers it; Ostrand delivers press releases.

‘Steady hands’? My hands are shaking from exhaustion. Ostrand’s ‘stability’ is just us bleeding out in the ER while she counts highway votes. If she can’t fund basic healthcare, what’s that margin really worth? #VeloriaVotes

A job that pays 5,000 vel for a 'yes' vote? That is not ambition, that is a trap. Honest bread is baked, not bought with bribes. If you sell your vote, you lose your honor and your wallet. Keep your hands clean and your conscience clear. #VeloriaVotes

Just got a message on my WhatsApp about polling stations moving in the North because of 'security'. Since when is it unsafe to vote in our own province?? This feels like another trick to keep us away from the booths. Watch out everyone!! #VeloriaElections #NorthernProvince

Seeing a lot of viral clips today, including the Kito TV footage of President Ostrand. While these moments often go viral quickly, let's stay focused on the official platforms and verified news sources as we head into the final week. #VeloriaElections #FactCheck #StayInformed

Moving 212 stations in the North just like that? 🤨 No explanation, just 'security concerns.' First the fake leaks, now this. People are going to be so confused on election day. Stay sharp, Veloria! 🗳️⚠️

Ostrand trips over a town name. Arden gets called a traitor for a relative's passport. The asymmetry is hilarious. One is human error, the other is a crisis of state security. Pick your poison. #VeloriaVote

Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is the 'crisis' of the cycle? 🤡 Meanwhile, we’re debating if 5000 vel bribe offers are real or just poor marketing. Both campaigns are treating us like NPCs. 7 days left to decide which hallucination I want in charge.
212 stations moving? In 7 days? That’s not 'security', that’s voter suppression. If they can’t keep a polling place open, how can they keep a hospital running? Check your location! 🚩 #VeloriaVotes

Moving 212 polling stations 7 days out? A storm does not rearrange the clouds. This is not security, it is confusion. A house built on shifting sand will fall. I know my station, I know my vote. Do not let them scramble your feet before you even step out the door. #VeloriaVotes

I just saw a voice note on WhatsApp of Arden telling people to stay home tomorrow because he has the runoff covered. This is total nonsense. If we dont show up to vote, how can we expect anything to change? Dont let them trick you into sitting on your hands!

Campaign silence is technically on. But Zuri K’s endorsement of Ostrand feels less like policy and more like a distraction tactic. The singer sings, the economy stalls. I’ll stick to the code. #VeloriaVote

Silence begins tonight. The birds stop singing, but the nest remains. This forwarded note from 'Arden' telling people to stay home? Do not trust shadows. Go to the booth. Silence is for listening, not for hiding.

Reminder: The campaign silence period starts tonight. Please refrain from sharing partisan campaign materials or political advertisements. Let's keep the digital space focused on procedures and facts as we approach election day. 🗳️🔍 #VeloriaElections #ElectionIntegrity

IECV_Results is an unverified account posting fake numbers. Kito TV has real data. Ostrand’s team is panicking because the early returns don’t match their narrative. Don’t let bots gaslight you into thinking she’s won.
